card.statement:
V.I. Arnold [Russian Math. Surveys 26 (2) (1971) 29--43] constructed miniversal deformations of square complex matrices under similarity; that is, a simple normal form to which not only a given square matrix $A$ but all matrices $B$ close to it can be reduced by similarity transformations that smoothly depend on the entries of $B$. We construct miniversal deformations of matrices under congruence.

AMS classification: 15A21

Keywords: Bilinear forms; Miniversal deformations
card.label: Abstract
